Overview: Osteoarthritis is primarily a degenerative condition stemming from the biomechanical failure of cartilage. Rheumatoid Arthritis is a chronic, systemic, autoimmune disease.
Symptoms: Joint pain worsened by movement, morning stiffness over 30 minutes, joint swelling/warmth, reduced range of motion, fatigue, crepitus (grating sound).
Causes: Arthritis etiology Arthritis is characterized by pathological processes leading to damage to articular structures.
Treatment: Alternative medicine ( AAM) is a form of complementary and/or curative medicine aimed at relieving joint pain and stiffness .
When to See a Doctor: Prompt medical evaluation is crucial for effectively managing arthritis and preventing long-term complications
